item.title: J Balvin Just Wore a Never-Before-Seen Air Jordan Collaboration at the Super Bowl

item.title: Jay-Z Adds a $394K Patek Philippe Celestial to His Super Bowl Watch Collection

item.title: Fragrance Brands Are Doubling Down on Innovative Formats — Again
item.description: The fragrance craze is entering jelly balm territory.

item.title: Moncler Grenoble Mounts Exhibit in Milan Timed With Winter Olympics
item.description: Titled “The Beyond Performance” exhibition, it retraces the brand’s key moments in history.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sacai Teams With Smythson on Mini Versions of Leather Briefcases, Travel Bags

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Loewe Has a New Chief Marketing Officer
item.description: Thierry Conrad Reutenauer, who joined the brand as global communications director last October, has been promoted to the role.

item.title: Donna Karan New York Fall 2026: Considered Modern Dress
item.description: The Donna Karan team put fabric innovation and modern wardrobing front and center for fall 2026.

item.title: Ferrari Style Lands on London’s Old Bond Street With Mega Flagship
item.description: The 9,150-square-foot store is meant to serve as a workshop of ideas, while reflecting the same ethos that defines Ferrari's design and engineering in car making.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Mike Faist, Sam Nivola and Will Price Join Ranks of Dior Brand Ambassadors
item.description: The actors are part of creative director Jonathan Anderson's inner circle.
